lines: Sixty-one years, three drivers, one beam. I am the third and I am not the last.
It has stopped four times. Twice for a valve, once for a flood, once for a funeral.
The funeral was the second driver's. We started it again before the tea.
Coal comes up from Harrowgate on a cart and the cart comes off a train.
So a machine two counties away is why this one turns over. I think about that.
Everything is joined to everything now. Nobody asked me and I do not mind.
